defeated_student_causes.why_failed: The Kruskal/union-find approach treats the problem like an ordinary minimum spanning-tree problem or otherwise greedily joins components; Steiner trees may require selecting a nonterminal relay structure that such greedy processing does not optimize.

The Floyd-Warshall-based approach appears to optimize connectivity among required sites using shortest-path distances, which can double-count paths and miss savings from a shared optional relay; shortest-path metric closure MST is not generally the Steiner-tree optimum.
